spells.name: Frost Nip
spells.description: A thin rime spreads over a small object or a creature's fingertips. The target is chilled and takes a bane on its next roll that needs a steady hand.

spells.name: Rime Ward
spells.description: You coat a creature in a shimmer of ice. The target gets +2 armor against fire damage and is immune to the effects of natural cold until the spell ends.

spells.name: Blizzard Call
description: A swirling storm of snow fills a sphere 10 meters across. Everyone inside has a bane on attacks and on AWARENESS rolls.
Fire in the area is doused at once.
